pilot_question: Which DAM/DAM X role, naming, formalization and integration assertions in the supplied secondary report can be decomposed faithfully, and which still need primary sources or independent evidence?
scope: Ten selected atomic units from seven report locations; report-faithful archaeology only, not an exhaustive corpus or reconstruction of original DAM X.

units.l0_original: DAM X sistem durumunu, değişebilir kuralları ve çevresel sınırları taşır.
units.l1_faithful_english: The report assigns DAM X responsibility for system state, changeable rules and environmental boundaries.
units.l2_decomposition: Separate a state model, rule-update model and environmental constraint contract. This is a proposed role, not demonstrated execution.
assumptions: Role boundaries and update semantics are unspecified.
units.formula_diagram_role: No mathematical formula or equation; prose role assignment/proposal.
units.mechanism_status: No executable DAM X mechanism or operator semantics supplied.
units.evidence_citation_target: Attributed to this secondary report only. P021 names DAM/DAM X summaries but supplies no primary locator or attached source; no empirical DAM X evidence is attached.
units.ambiguities: Report proposal/assessment must not be conflated with original-model wording or validated mechanism.
